maps.notes: Preferred comp per map point. Sided modes give separate attack and defense preferences. Weights per preference sum to 1.

archetypes.notes: How much each hero leans into dive, poke and brawl play. Weights per hero sum to 1.

archetypes.dive: Jump onto isolated or backline targets with mobility and burst.
archetypes.poke: Win from range with sightlines, sustained damage and high-ground control.
archetypes.brawl: Group up close, absorb damage and win short-range fights through sustain.
